The IMD predicts thunderstorms accompanied by strong winds and hailstorms for several districts including Jaipur, Ajmer, Bharatpur, Kota, and Udaipur.  A new western disturbance is expected to bring further rain to the region from April 6th.

recent_articles.title: NSUI workers clash with police over RSS-linked event in Rajasthan University - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NSUI** members clashed with police at **Rajasthan University** on Friday, protesting a seminar organized by the **Marudhara Nari Sashaktikaran Sangathan**, a group affiliated with the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh**.  The protest stemmed from concerns that the event promoted RSS ideology and was inappropriate for the university's academic environment. **NSUI** leader Amardeep Parihar demanded the program be canceled, citing a similar event in September 2025 that led to a confrontation.  Senior Congress leaders **Ashok Gehlot**, **Govind Singh Dotasra**, and **Tika Ram Jully** condemned the police action and called for the release of detained protesters.

recent_articles.title: Man found dead in Cubbon Park - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suresh Kumar Purohit**, a worker at a shop on S.P. Road in **Rajasthan**, was found dead by hanging in **Cubbon Park** on Friday morning.  Police are treating the death as a self-harm case and have registered an unnatural death report. Purohit had been missing since Thursday night, prompting a search initiated by his friends who filed a missing person complaint at the Halasur Gate Police Station. The police have informed his family members and await their arrival to complete further procedures.

recent_articles.title: Rajasthan HC expunges its own remarks that Trans Amendment Act dilutes ‘constitutional guarantees’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan High Court** modified its March 30th ruling on a transgender rights case, deleting portions that criticized the recently enacted Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Act, 2026. The court clarified that these observations were "included by mistake" and not intended or necessary.  While retaining its stance that the right to self-identify one's gender is a fundamental right, the court acknowledged the amendment bill's passage and directed the State government to ensure any policy framework developed remains within the existing legal framework of March 30th, 2026.

recent_articles.title: Rajasthan HC issues contempt notices over delay in panchayat, local body elections - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan High Court** issued contempt notices to the **State Election Commission (SEC)** and Election Commissioner Rajeshwar Singh for delaying the conduct of Panchayati Raj and urban local body elections despite a previous order. The court questioned the SEC's schedule for voter list revision, which extended beyond the deadline set by the court.  The petition was filed by former MLA Sanyam Lodha, who argued that the State government and SEC were deliberately delaying the elections to avoid holding them by April 15th. The court has asked the Commission to explain why it announced the voter list review program beyond the deadline.

recent_articles.title: Census 2027 kicks off: How to do self-enumeration: step-by-step guide - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner will conduct the 2027 census, a massive administrative and statistical exercise that collects demographic data on the entire country. The self-enumeration facility allows citizens to provide their household information online before enumerators visit, offering flexibility in filling out the census schedule.  The dates for self-enumeration vary by state and union territory, with most starting in April 2026. Census data is expected to be published within 2027 due to the digital nature of the process.

recent_articles.title: Kerala election 2026: Polls heat up as major fronts step up campaigns and identity politics takes centrestage - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: With the Kerala Assembly polls approaching, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra** are among the high-profile figures campaigning. The election has become increasingly polarized with accusations of backroom deals and communal overtures from groups like the SDPI and JIH.  The ruling **CPI(M)-led Left Democratic Front (LDF)** is highlighting a decade of development, while the **United Democratic Front (UDF)** faces internal strife over its leadership and attempts to revive the Sabarimala gold theft scandal. The BJP seeks to expand its vote share into actual seats, but faces challenges from the FCRA issue with the Christian electorate.

recent_articles.title: 24 districts in Rajasthan to get electricity for irrigation during daytime - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma** announced that daytime electricity for irrigation will be provided to farmers in Dausa and Karauli districts, expanding the scheme to 24 districts in Rajasthan.  The initiative aims to benefit approximately 52,400 agricultural consumers in Dausa and 35,300 in Karauli by reducing nighttime irrigation needs and mitigating risks from wild animals. **Jaipur Discom** will oversee power supply in these areas, while **Ajmer Discom**, **Jodhpur Discom**, and **Sirohi** are also involved in the project.

recent_articles.title: ‘Regional imbalance’ bothers Congress as government plans delimitation to roll out women’s reservation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union government** has proposed to implement the women's reservation law by 2029 using the 2011 Census data, reversing its previous stance. This proposal has prompted the **Congress** to call for an all-party meeting to discuss potential implications of such a move. The Congress argues that a uniform 50% increase in seats could widen the representation gap between states with larger populations and those with smaller populations.  The party is also seeking clarity on how the government plans to address demands for representation of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes within the women's reservation framework.

recent_articles.title: Russian artist's photo shoot with elephant painted pink in Rajasthan draws ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A controversy has erupted over the death of an elephant named Chanchal, who was painted pink for a photo shoot in Jaipur. **Julia Buruleva**, a photographer, shared images and videos of the shoot online, sparking criticism about animal welfare.  **Sadik Khan**, the elephant's owner, stated that the paint used was organic and washed off immediately after the photoshoot, which lasted for 10 minutes. However, officials have said Chanchal died from natural causes last month. Animal rights activists have called for stricter oversight on the use of animals in commercial activities.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal election 2026: BJP trying to add illegal voters from outside in Bengal electoral rolls: Mamata Banerjee - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, West Bengal Chief Minister, accused the **BJP** of attempting to include illegal voters from other states in the state's electoral rolls to manipulate election results. She alleged that the party is planning to transport out-of-state voters using railways and colluding with the Election Commission to delete names of women and minorities from the voter list.  Banerjee vowed to fight against these attempts, claiming the BJP seeks to impose a "ban on non-veg food consumption" in Bengal if elected and plans to implement NRC through a backdoor.

recent_articles.title: 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scores 15-ball fifty for Rajasthan Royals | Cricket News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vaibhav Sooryavanshi**, a 15-year-old Indian teenager, scored a blistering 15-ball half century for **Rajasthan Royals** in their eight-wicket victory over **Chennai Super Kings**.  Sooryavanshi's aggressive innings came after his team restricted the visitors to a low score, leading to a quick chase and an easy win. The young batter credited his coach **Kumar Sangakkara** and staff for supporting his attacking style of play.

recent_articles.title: 1.22 lakh Anganwadi workers in Rajasthan get ₹1,000 each through DBT - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajasthan** Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma transferred ₹1,000 each to 1.22 lakh Anganwadi workers through direct benefit transfer (DBT) to cover the cost of two uniforms. He also announced a 10% increase in honorarium for Anganwadi workers, helpers, and midday meal cooks-cum-helpers, effective April 1st.  Sharma highlighted the crucial role of Anganwadi workers in nation-building and emphasized steps taken to strengthen these centers. The Chief Minister also encouraged Anganwadi workers' participation in his "developed village-ward" campaign.

recent_articles.title: Putting trans people under OBC quota gives no real benefit, says Rajasthan High Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan High Court** ruled that the state's classification of transgender people as part of the OBC category for reservations is ineffective and discriminatory. The court criticized the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, which removes the right to self-identification.  The court ordered the formation of a committee to assess the compounded marginalization of transgender individuals from all socio-economic categories. The court also directed that transgender individuals be given a 3% additional weightage in selection and appointment for state educational institutions or government posts.

recent_articles.title: NDA, Opposition spar in LS over efforts to free country of Maoism - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJP** and **NDA** members in the Lok Sabha criticized the previous **UPA** government for its handling of Maoism, accusing it of failing to contain the threat.  They highlighted significant reductions in the "red corridor" under the current administration and emphasized the success of policies like Operation Green Hunt and the creation of CoBRA. The Congress countered by pointing to efforts made during their tenure, including the establishment of the Commando Battalion for Resolute Action (CoBRA) and emphasizing a balanced approach that prioritized both security and welfare.  The debate highlighted contrasting approaches to combating Maoism between the two governments.

recent_articles.title: Sonia Gandhi shows 'excellent progress', discharge expected soon, say doctors - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sonia Gandhi**, a senior Congress leader, has made excellent progress and is now "absolutely normal" after being admitted to **Sir Ganga Ram Hospital** on March 24th with a fever. Doctors confirmed that she remains on IV antibiotics for the next few days but all her parameters are within normal limits. A decision regarding her discharge will be made jointly by doctors and the patient, who is currently stable and under observation briefly as a precaution.

recent_articles.title: The rise of temporary teachers in West Bengal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **West Bengal's** higher education system is characterized by a high reliance on temporary teachers, exceeding national norms. The state consistently maintains a share of temporary faculty above 15%, significantly higher than other major states like Rajasthan and Tamil Nadu. This trend has been observed for over a decade despite growth in permanent teaching positions remaining relatively stable.  The limited expansion of institutions and a strained student-teacher ratio contribute to the reliance on temporary teachers, which may have fiscal benefits but negatively impact teaching quality and exacerbate existing inequities. Addressing these structural constraints is crucial for West Bengal's higher education system to ensure long-term success in developing a skilled workforce.

recent_articles.title: Despite assurance from Centre, MGNREGS workers denied work - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **MGNREGS** workers across several districts in Bihar and Rajasthan are protesting the lack of work under the scheme despite assurances from the **Union government**.  Workers claim they have not received any work for months, even before the new rural employment law was introduced.  The **Centre** is currently holding talks with States to establish the necessary framework for the new scheme, but workers say they are being told to wait for further instructions. This lack of clarity has led to protests and uncertainty about future work assignments under MGNREGA.

recent_articles.title: What is the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Bill? | Explained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** government passed the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Bill, 2026, which aims to prohibit unlawful religious conversions. The bill mandates a 60-day notice period for conversion and requires police registration of complaints related to forced conversions.  Civil society organizations have expressed concerns about the bill's potential impact on personal liberty and its constitutionality.  The bill has been supported by **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, who stated that it is necessary to address increasing cases of forcible religious conversions. The bill has also been criticized for potentially targeting minority communities and raising administrative concerns regarding the lack of a certification system for religions.

recent_articles.title: Fast justice for Zubeen Garg among five Congress guarantees for Assam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, Congress president, promised **justice for Zubeen Garg** within 100 days if elected in Assam.  He also outlined other guarantees including ₹50,000 to women for business ventures and monthly cash transfers, ₹1,250 pension for senior citizens, ₹25 lakh cashless health cover for families, and land rights for 10 lakh indigenous people. **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, Assam's Chief Minister, claimed Garg's death was part of a conspiracy while a Singapore coroner ruled it an accidental drowning.

recent_articles.title: News in Frames: Licensed to bloom - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** **Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN)** regulates the cultivation of opium poppy in select regions, with farmers primarily located in Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan.  The practice is deeply ingrained in local traditions, with families cultivating the crop for generations and relying on licenses to secure financial benefits and marriage prospects for their children. The CBN issues two types of licenses: one for extracting latex from the capsules (gum) and another for procuring the capsule itself (concentrate of poppy straw). Farmers harvest the opium after Holi in March, employing skilled labor and protective measures against wildlife like nilgais.

recent_articles.title: Great Indian Bustard chick born in Gujarat after a decade through jumpstart approach: Environment Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Ministry of Environment, Forest, and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav** announced the successful hatching of a Great Indian Bustard (GIB) chick in Gujarat, marking a significant conservation achievement.  The chick was transported from Rajasthan to Gujarat via road after an incubation period lasting over 19 hours. The initiative, coordinated by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest, and Climate Change (MoEFCC)**, involved collaboration with state forest departments and the **Wildlife Institute of India**. This inter-state effort is part of the **Project GIB**, launched in 2016 to conserve the critically endangered species.

recent_articles.title: Protesters lift dharna at Kotputli after assurance on NGT judgment compliance - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The residents of Jodhpura village in Rajasthan** lifted their dharna outside the District Collectorate after an assurance from the administration that a judgment by the **National Green Tribunal (NGT)** would be complied with. The NGT had ordered **UltraTech Cement**, which operates a limestone crusher and cement plant at Jodhpura, to pay compensation for health and environmental damage and develop a green belt.  The villagers have been protesting against the plant's impact on their health and environment for over three years, citing issues like pollution, cracks in houses, and health problems.

recent_articles.title: ‘Stree Nidhi’ to take up staff recruitment soon: Seethakka - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Stree Nidhi Credit Cooperative Federation Limited
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Danasari Anasuya**, **Minister of Panchayati Raj and Rural Development**, announced government approval for 163 new appointments at the Stree Nidhi Credit Cooperative Federation Limited.  She also praised the federation's growth, noting its strong financial position with a loan portfolio exceeding ₹5,500 crore. The Minister highlighted the federation's success in expanding digital access and enabling post office cash transactions in remote areas.

recent_articles.title: Electors pitch for business development, peace and harmony in Harbour Assembly constituency - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DMK** led Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) has initiated electoral roll revisions in the Harbour Assembly Constituency, resulting in the removal of over 12,000 names from northern states. Residents like Mitha Lal and R. Barathan highlight the positive impact of the government's policies on business growth and social harmony.  However, challenges remain such as stray cattle attacks, inadequate infrastructure, and traffic congestion. The BJP faces an uphill battle due to the removal of significant numbers of north Indian voters during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR).

recent_articles.title: BJD demands VAT reduction on petrol, diesel in Odisha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **BJD** leaders in **Odisha** criticized the state government's handling of fuel prices, demanding a reduction in Value Added Tax (VAT) to match the Centre's excise duty cut.  The party cited concerns over global fuel shortages and public anxiety about supply disruptions, arguing that the state should prioritize uninterrupted fuel access. They also pointed out that **Odisha** has one of the highest VAT rates on fuel compared to other states.

recent_articles.title: Vaibhav Suryavanshi: The 15-year-old Indian that cricket can no longer ignore
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The 15-year-old Indian batter Vaibhav Suryavanshi is poised to make history as the youngest player in the IPL.  **Suryavanshi**, who turned 15 on March 27th, has already made a name for himself with impressive performances at various youth levels and his recent century in the IPL. The question now is whether he's ready for the world stage.  His talent has been recognized by many former cricketers, including Ravi Shastri, AB de Villiers, Matthew Hayden, WV Raman, and Sachin Tendulkar, who have praised his skills and maturity.

recent_articles.title: CPI(M)’s criticism of Rahul Gandhi to please BJP: Sachin Pilot - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sachin Pilot**, general secretary of the **All India Congress Committee**, accused **Pinarayi Vijayan**, chief minister of Kerala, and the **CPI(M)** of making allegations against **Rahul Gandhi** to appease the **BJP**.  Pilot alleged that these accusations are part of a deal between the two parties. He also criticized the LDF government's handling of issues like cooking gas shortages and economic development in the state.

recent_articles.title: US investors bet big on Indian cricket with record billion-dollar IPL deals | Sport News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **US** investors made record-breaking billion-dollar deals for two Indian Premier League teams, the Rajasthan Royals and Royal Challengers Bengaluru.  The deals mark a significant jump from previous sales and highlight the growing allure of India's national pastime among international investors. **Kal Somani**, **Rob Walton**, **David Blitzer**, and other US businessmen are part of the new ownership groups for both teams. The IPL, with its global reach and massive audience, is attracting substantial investment as businesses seek to tap into the sport's popularity in India and beyond.
